newsitem.title: INDIA: India ONGC to adapt ship for deep waters.
newsitem.headline: India ONGC to adapt ship for deep waters.

text.p: The state-run Oil and Natural Gas Corp (ONGC) is adapting its drillship Sagar Vijay for deep water exploration upto 900 metres, a company official told an exploration seminar on Thursday.
"The trend worldwide is to upgrade," the official said. Charter rates for deep sea vessels were as high as $100,000-125,000 per day, the official said.
ONGC officials said there were 18 prospects in offshore Kerala/Konkan deep waters which the firm planned to drill in 1997/98 (April-March).
In the Krishna-Godavari offshore waters off the east coast, 10 prospects have been firmed up for exploration, they said.
Earlier, ONGC chairman B.C. Bora said the firm planned to invest about 3.0 billion rupees over two years in deep water exploration.
